html:
PACKAGE TOUR: 2.960.000VNĐ/PAX

(the price for shared tour)

SERVICE PRICE
Community Homestay in Phung village & hotel in Bac Ha 2.960.000 vnd/pax
Private room in Phung village & hotel nin Bac Ha

3.080.000 vnd/pax

SHADULE OF DEPARTURE

SEPTEMBER 2024 OCTOBER 2024
31/08, 01, 13, 20, 27 04, 11, 18, 25

TOUR PRICE INCLUDES

• New, air-conditioned car/ bus for follow the itinerary

• 01 night hotel in Bac Ha: 2 guests/room, odd number of 3.

• 01 night of community homestay in Phung village.

• 04 main meals 150,000 VND/person/meal, 01 main meal 180,000 VND/person/meal

• • Breakfast 40,000 VND/meal.

• Entrance tickets as mention in the itinerary

• • Drinking water 500ml/person/day

• Tour guide serving throughout the tour (enthusiastic, experienced)

• Maximum tour travel insurance of 30,000,000 VND/case

TOUR NOT INCLUDED

• Drinks during meals.

• Motorbike taxi to Thau stream Steppe: 100,000 – 150,000 VND/person

• Expenses outside the tour program

• VAT

• Tip tour guide and driver.

CHILDREN POLICY

• Children from 9 years charged 100% of aduld price

• Children from 5 to under 9 years old are charged 75% of tour price.

• Children under 4 years old are free.

• SURCHARGE REGULATIONS

• Single room 500,000 VND/person/2 nights

• Foreign guests: 350,000 VND according to regulations

NOTE

• Each family can be attached 1 child onloy under 5 years old. If there is a 2nd child or more, 50% of the tour price will be charged.

• The tour schedule may change but still ensures all the attractions.
outline: Day 1: HA NOI – BAC QUANG –  PHUNG  VILLAGE– HOANG SU PHI   ( Meal, lunch, dinner)
Day 2: PHUNG VILLAGE – COC PAI – SUOI THAU STEPPE ( Meal: lunch, dinner)
Day 3: CHỢ PHIÊN BẮC HÀ – DINH HOÀNG A TƯỞNG – HÀ NỘI      ( Ăn sáng trưa)
